card.name: Words just before 'source' of supply
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected 'source' or 'sources', such as other, only, nitrogen, find, or will come from. It appears in text about where water, food, nutrients or resources come from.

modes.label: Modifier before source
modes.description: A modifier like other, only, nitrogen or vegetarian sits right before the word source.
modes.example: there may be no<< other>> source of fresh water.

modes.label: Verb of finding supply
modes.description: A verb or phrase about finding or supplying a resource, where source is likely next.
modes.example: reduce water use and to<< find>> a solution to its sudden water shortage.

modes.label: Used as a supply
modes.description: Words like 'used as' or 'look elsewhere' that lead into a supply or source phrase.
modes.example: purposefully used<< as>> a raw water supply for another water treatment

card.writes: It promotes the word source and its plural, in English and Chinese, so the next word is likely 'source(s)'.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name where something comes from, such as a source of water or food.
